name: Rice
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 120:60:40 kg/ha, split-applied with basal + tillering + panicle-initiation doses.
challenges: Needs standing water or assured irrigation
Susceptible to blast and stem borer
Sensitive to delayed transplanting

name: Wheat
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 120:60:40 kg/ha; nitrogen split at sowing, crown-root, and jointing stages.
challenges: Yield drops sharply if sown after mid-December
Vulnerable to terminal heat stress
Rust in humid years

name: Cotton
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha with an additional potash top-dressing at boll development.
challenges: Bollworm and pink bollworm pressure
Long duration ties up land for 8+ months
Price volatility at harvest

name: Sugarcane
growingMonths: Planted Feb – Mar or Oct – Nov, 10–12 month cycle
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 250:115:115 kg/ha applied in three to four split doses across the crop cycle.
challenges: Very high, near-continuous water demand
Heavy nutrient drain on soil
Red rot disease in ratoon crops

name: Maize
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 120:60:40 kg/ha; responds strongly to nitrogen top-dressing at knee-high stage.
challenges: Fall armyworm is a recurring pest
Waterlogging causes rapid yield loss
Needs timely weeding in first 30 days

name: Groundnut
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 25:50:75 kg/ha with gypsum applied at flowering for pod filling.
challenges: Vulnerable to prolonged dry spells at pegging
Leaf spot and rust in humid pockets
Needs well-drained loose soil for pod development

name: Soybean
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 20:60:40 kg/ha; rhizobium seed treatment reduces nitrogen need.
challenges: Excess moisture causes root rot
Girdle beetle and pod borer damage
Poor storage life at high humidity

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 40:20:20 kg/ha; thrives on modest inputs in low-fertility soils.
challenges: Downy mildew in wet years
Bird damage near ripening
Market demand narrower than cereals like wheat

name: Sorghum (Jowar)
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 80:40:40 kg/ha with nitrogen split between sowing and 30 days after.
challenges: Shoot fly at seedling stage
Grain mould in humid harvest windows
Requires bird-scaring near maturity

name: Chickpea (Gram)
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 20:50:20 kg/ha; avoid excess nitrogen, which delays pod set.
challenges: Pod borer is the primary pest
Wilt in poorly drained fields
Frost damage during flowering in northern belts

name: Mustard
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 80:40:40 kg/ha plus sulphur, which materially improves oil content.
challenges: Aphid infestation in cool, humid spells
White rust in dense canopies
Needs one to two critical irrigations only

name: Tea
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 120:40:40 kg/ha/year in split monthly doses through the plucking season.
challenges: Needs well-distributed rainfall through the year
Labour-intensive plucking cycle
Blister blight in high-humidity flushes

name: Coconut
fertilizerRecommendation: 0.5 kg N, 0.32 kg P2O5, 1.2 kg K2O per palm per year, split across two doses.
challenges: Long gestation before first bearing
Rhinoceros beetle and red palm weevil
Root wilt disease in some coastal tracts

name: Potato
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 180:80:100 kg/ha with potash split at planting and earthing-up.
challenges: Late blight in cool, humid weather
Needs cold storage soon after harvest
Sensitive to waterlogging at tuber stage

name: Chili
fertilizerRecommendation: NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha with calcium and boron sprays to reduce fruit drop.
challenges: Thrips and mite complex ('leaf curl')
Anthracnose fruit rot in wet harvest windows
Price swings between seasons
